1988. Number Format Validator

60

Medium

Problem Statement

Given a string, attempt to convert it to an integer. Handle the case where the string does not represent a valid number using exception handling.

Description

Read a single line of text. Attempt to convert it into an integer. If the text is not a valid integer, an exception is thrown; catch it and print an error message instead of the converted value.
input_spec: A single line containing a string, str.
output_spec: If str can be converted to a valid integer, print that integer. Otherwise, print "Error: Invalid number format".
